name: violet_breath_cone
for: warped_drake violet breath: the breath pouring from the mouth while it lasts
notes: Loop at the mouth (pivot = mouth): a cone of churning violet vapour pouring +x and 20 deg down, a bright core and waving energy tongues along its axis, short violet-white crackles flickering on twos, motes and hard sparks streaming out, billows rolling at the far end where it is ~1.4 m tall (~2.9 m long). NOTE: the warped_drake breath sprite frames already carry a flat white blob at the mouth; it should be removed from the sprite or hidden under this clip.
